about_the_game:
A Story-Driven Space Epic
Your journey is not without purpose; it is a grand space opera starring you. As the leader of human civilization, you will personally take part in a series of decisive historical events. Your decisions will not only influence the rise and fall of your empire but also guide the narrative down different branches, ultimately determining the fate of humanity in this universe. Will you fight to break the strings of destiny, or accept an end that seems already written?

Explore a Universe Full of Secrets
You are about to step into a universe filled with the dust of ages past. Here, every star sector, every ruin, holds secrets waiting to be unearthed. The rise and fall of all civilizations, the shifting of empires, all seem to follow a certain, predetermined cycle and pattern. The history of this universe is perhaps far colder and more deliberate than any record tells. Dispatch your exploration teams, decipher the legacy of lost civilizations, and gradually piece together the hidden history behind this galaxy. These discoveries will not only greatly enhance your empire's strength but are also key to understanding the entire lore.

Strategize and Build Your Empire
As the leader of humanity, you must start from a single foothold and gradually build a powerful interstellar empire.

Plan Your Homeworlds: Carefully plan planetary development, balancing the growth of industry, agriculture, technology, and civilian life to lay a solid foundation for your empire's expansion.
Research Unique Technologies: Beyond the common tech tree, through exploration and narrative choices, you will have the chance to acquire unique lost technologies, setting your civilization on a distinct path.
Design Your Fleets: Utilize a modular design system to freely assemble your star fleets. From agile assault craft to durable capital ships, create an invincible armada capable of executing your strategic will.

Contend with Ancient Civilizations
In this ancient sea of stars, several powerful civilizations have long since risen. They have their own histories, ambitions, and rules. You will enter this stage as an emerging power, engaging them in a complex game of diplomacy. Within the web of relationships woven by these old hegemons, you must find a breakthrough for humanity through trade, alliances, deterrence, and even war.

short_description: Lead humanity's last Ark and rebuild civilization in a cosmos dominated by ancient powers. Start from nothing, build your fleet, and develop new technology. Forge alliances or wage war to survive—humanity's future is in your hands.
